root_idea.summary: The root centers on time, especially the early part of the day, and on going forth during that period.
root_idea.development: From the temporal notion of the early morning developed the verb غَدَا, nouns for morning periods and tomorrow, the morning meal, morning-related clouds, and places or activities associated with morning.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The QAC lemma spelling غَدَوٰة is normalized to the established citation form غَدَاةٌ for the supplied Quran occurrences.

senses.definition: To go forth or depart in the early part of the morning.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage includes going early to or toward a person, place, or thing, especially in the construction غَدَا عَلَى. The supplied occurrences include perfect and imperative forms.

senses.definition: Tomorrow; the day following the present day.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is used for the coming day, including in expressions such as غَدًا and لِغَدٍ.

senses.definition: The morning meal; a meal eaten in the early part of the day.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence denotes the meal itself, not the time at which it is eaten.

senses.definition: The early morning; the first part of the day.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ, it is paired with the evening period. The expression has been interpreted as the times of the dawn and afternoon prayers, or more generally as regularity in worship.

senses.definition: Morning time or morning going-forth; a morning course or activity.
senses.usage_conditions: As a verbal noun, it can denote the early-morning period or movement in it. Quranic usage contrasts it with evening or return and includes the sense of a morning course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go, depart, or hasten to a person, place, or task at any time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an extension from the primary early-morning sense; the construction may indicate going to or attending something without restricting the time of day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed someone the meal called غَدَاءٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative verb referring to providing the morning meal.
The same verb may refer to eating the pre-dawn meal during Ramadan, because it serves the corresponding function for a fasting person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to pasture in the first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use applied to camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A future time expected to come, whether near or relatively remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an extended temporal use beyond the ordinary designation of the next day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression ابن غداتين, two days old.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional age expression meaning literally one who belongs to two mornings or days.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A journey made in the first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is opposed to رَوْحَةٌ, a journey or departure in the later part of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The early part of the morning or first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer specifically to the period between the dawn prayer and sunrise, or more broadly to the morning before or after sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The unborn offspring of a pregnant animal; also a sale made in exchange for such unborn offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for a hazardous transaction involving what an animal will give birth to; variant forms are reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eating the meal called غَدَاءٌ; breakfast-eating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source also records related feminine forms used adjectivally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pasture of camels in the first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is distinct from the meal noun غَدَاءٌ and is understood from the morning-time association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to tomorrow or the morrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from غَدٌ.
A figurative designation based on the lion's going forth against prey in the early morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud arising in the morning, or a morning rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote either the morning cloud or the rain associated with it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place to which people go or return in the morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is opposed to مَرَاحٌ or مَرَاحَةٌ, a destination or movement associated with the later part of the day.
